instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Generic drug manufacturer producing oral solid dosage forms (tablets, capsules) across 8 therapeutic categories. EU GMP-certified manufacturing facility with capacity for 2 billion tablets annually. Currently investing in continuous manufacturing line technology to replace batch processing for high-volume products. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers. Decision-making is fast and informal, but we lack the specialized expertise in-house to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget, no structured ideation process, and no track record of experimenting with new technologies or business models beyond basic operational necessity.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.

input.changes_since_last: Completed 8 strategic partnerships. Revenue growth 20% YoY. Exploring AI/ML capabilities.

opportunities.title: Establishing Specialized Advisory Network for Tech Validation
opportunities.rationale: The company is exploring advanced technologies (AI/ML, continuous manufacturing) but lacks specialized in-house expertise to evaluate complex investments. Formalizing a network of external technical consultants mitigates risk and accelerates decision-making without immediate high fixed costs.

first_actions: Define specific technology domains requiring expert validation (e.g., continuous flow optimization, NLP for drug discovery).
Identify 3-5 boutique consulting firms or academic partnerships specializing in these gaps.
Draft an RFP focused on capability assessment rather than immediate project execution.
execution_plan.success_metric: Signed agreement with 2 external advisory partners providing validated scope of work.
milestones: Resource allocation approved for next phase.

opportunities.title: Developing Repeatable Enterprise Sales Motion and Pricing Models
opportunities.rationale: Achieving the €50M ARR target requires moving beyond opportunistic, one-time sales. A structured sales motion that emphasizes recurring revenue models (e.g., service contracts, subscription analytics) is necessary to scale the addressable market effectively.

first_actions: Audit existing customer relationships to identify natural opportunities for service contract attachment rates.
Pilot 2 different pricing/revenue model structures (e.g., usage-based vs. retainer) on small client segments.
Develop a preliminary sales playbook template centered around value proposition mapping.
execution_plan.success_metric: Creation and successful internal piloting of 2 defined revenue models leading to a signed commitment.
milestones: Market segmentation finalized (defining ideal customer profile).
Pilot results analyzed and model refined.
Sales team training completed on new playbooks.

next_steps.action: Formalize an internal 'Innovation Guild' or cross-functional steering committee to manage ideation and prioritization, reducing reliance on owner decision-making.
Allocate dedicated seed budget ($5k-$10k) specifically for structured, external consulting assessments related to AI/ML integration.
Conduct a comprehensive review of the current talent structure to identify specific skill gaps related to continuous manufacturing process optimization and recurring revenue sales.

key_weaknesses: Lack of structured innovation governance; reliance on ad-hoc, reactive problem-solving.
High single point of failure risk due to owner-alone decision-making structure.
Talent gap in evaluating complex, high-tech investments (AI/ML, continuous manufacturing).

improvements: Secured 8 strategic partnerships, significantly expanding external validation and reach.
Achieved strong revenue growth of 20% YoY, validating initial market traction.
Proactively exploring advanced technologies (AI/ML, continuous manufacturing) showing increased ambition.
persistent_gaps: Innovation process remains unstructured; no dedicated ideation budget or formal initiative structure.
Operational growth is driving revenue, but the underlying sales and market strategy needs to be formalized for scale.
Internal management layers are limited, slowing down systemic scalability.
achieved_milestones: Initial technical scoping completed for continuous manufacturing transition.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shift from theoretical need recognition to tangible operational execution (partnerships, revenue growth). The focus has matured from merely existing to actively seeking structured paths towards high-ambition scaling (€50M ARR).
